bfm_rule: a conditional Bernoulli-transition experiment is justified only if the disposition is BINARY_OBSERVER_FEASIBLE and a USEFUL perf-PASS encoder also passes S4 with mean per-bit entropy >= 0.5 bit and <= 10% constant bits
rule: MECHANICS_BLOCKED if any M gate fails; else BINARY_OBSERVER_NOT_USEFUL if no encoder is USEFUL; else PERFORMANCE_NONPASS if every USEFUL encoder is perf NONPASS; else INCONCLUSIVE if no USEFUL encoder is perf PASS; else BINARY_OBSERVER_FEASIBLE
